propositions: Structured-output validation and recovery must execute through one Pydantic Agent operation with approved shared request budget, verified by retry-contract tests covering tool turns, output retries, and exhaustion
Retry context must preserve complete failed response on proven fit and omit it whole otherwise, verified by complete/omit and oversize-input tests
Rebar must preserve deterministic extraction, fallback eligibility, terminal refusal/filter behavior, typed exhaustion, final-failure artifacts, and answering-model provenance
Successful operations must report complete Pydantic run usage exactly once while fallback/downgrade candidates remain trace or journal events rather than competing usage counters
Bespoke structured-output retry loop removal is deferred pending compatibility suite and authorized Anthropic/Bedrock cache canaries pass verification
